title: spermacoce laeta
intro: Spermacoce laeta, commonly known as the 'Yellow Buttons', is a species of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce laeta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Spermacoce laeta to include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
